description_en: Queries the records of batch device registration
description_zh: 调用该接口查询设备批量注册的记录信息
name: QueryGenerateDevicesRecord

parameters.help_en: The number of records per page. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 指定返回结果中每页显示的记录数量，最大值是100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number to return. Maximum value: 1000
parameters.help_zh: 指定显示返回结果中的第几页，最大值为1,000
parameters.name: page_no

parameters.help_en: The start time in millisecond-level UNIX timestamp
parameters.help_zh: 起始时间的毫秒级时间戳
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time in millisecond-level UNIX timestamp.

<notice> The interval between the start time and end time cannot exceed 30 days.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
结束时间的毫秒级时间戳。

<notice> 起止时间间隔不能超过30天。
</notice>
parameters.name: end_time

Code.description_en:
The result code of the call:
A value of 200 indicates success.
Any other value indicates failure. For more information, see Error codes in this topic
Code.description_zh:
调用结果状态码：
调用成功，返回200。
调用失败，返回错误码。详细信息，请参见下文错误码

Data.description_en: The result returned if the call was successful

ListData.description_en: The details of the device registration records
ListData.description_zh: 设备注册记录的详细信息

ApplyDeviceCount.description_en: The number of devices applied for

BatchId.description_en: The batch ID of the application

BatchStatus.description_en:
The batch status of the batch registration. Valid values:

CREATE: Devices are being created.
CREATE_SUCCESS: All devices in the application were created.
CREATE_FAILED: Some devices in the application failed to be created
BatchStatus.description_zh:
批量注册的批次状态。

CREATE：正在创建设备。
CREATE_SUCCESS：申请单中的所有设备创建成功。
CREATE_FAILED：申请单中有设备创建失败

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the batch registration task was submitted, in millisecond-level UNIX timestamp
CreateTime.description_zh: 批量注册设备任务的提交时间，格式为毫秒级时间戳

NetworkType.description_en:
The network connectivity type of the product. Valid values:

WIFI: Wi-Fi.
CELLULAR: cellular (GPRS/3G/4G/5G).
ETHERNET: Ethernet.
OTHER: other network type
NetworkType.description_zh:
产品的连网方式。取值：

WIFI：Wi-Fi。
CELLULAR：蜂窝GPRS/3G/4G/5G。
ETHERNET：以太网。
OTHER：其他网络类型

OperateUid.description_en: The UID of the account that performed the operation

ProductKey.description_en: The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs

ProductName.description_en: The name of the product to which the device belongs

SpecCode.description_en:
The activation code specification. Valid values:

Consumer_IPC_512Kbps: consumer IPC 512 Kbps.
Consumer_IPC_1Mbps: consumer IPC 1 Mbps.
Consumer_IPC_2Mbps: consumer IPC 2 Mbps.
Consumer_IPC_4Mbps: consumer IPC 4 Mbps.
Industry_IPC: industry IPC.
NVR_Less64: network video recorder with 64 or fewer channels.
NVR_Higher64: network video recorder with more than 64 channels
SpecCode.description_zh:
激活码规格Code。取值：

Consumer_IPC_512Kbps：消费类IPC 512Kbps。
Consumer_IPC_1Mbps：消费类IPC 1Mbps。
Consumer_IPC_2Mbps：消费类IPC 2Mbps。
Consumer_IPC_4Mbps：消费类IPC 4Mbps。
Industry_IPC：行业类IPC。
NVR_Less64：NVR小于等于64路。
NVR_Higher64：NVR大于64路

SuccessCount.description_en: The number of devices that were successfully registered in the batch
SuccessCount.description_zh: 批量注册设备成功的设备数量

PageSize.description_en: The number of records per page

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
